notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 69-year-old male admitted for upper GI bleed. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.7, creatinine 1.02, hemoglobin 13.9, platelets 299, sodium 139, wbc 9; vitals dbp 79-82, heart_rate 80-86, map 91-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 115-118, spo2 97-98, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: EGD: mild nonbleeding gastritis; Pantoprazole 80 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Acute blood loss anemia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.04, hemoglobin 14, platelets 297, sodium 139, wbc 8.9; vitals dbp 78-82, heart_rate 81-85, map 92-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 116-121, spo2 96-98, temp 37-37.1
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Acute blood loss anemia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 69-year-old male, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Upper GI bleed. Acute blood loss anemia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
